changelog: Initial release - GitHub Actions workflow creation for Node.js, Python, Go, and Rust. Matrix builds, caching, deployment patterns, Docker build/push, npm publish, secrets management, and debugging.
summary: Create, debug, and manage CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Use when the user needs to set up automated testing, deployment, releases, or workflows. Covers workflow syntax, common patterns, secrets management, caching, matrix builds, and troubleshooting.
